properties.displayName: An Azure Active Directory administrator should be provisioned for SQL servers
properties.description: Audit provisioning of an Azure Active Directory administrator for your SQL server to enable Azure AD authentication. Azure AD authentication enables simplified permission management and centralized identity management of database users and other Microsoft services Enabled=true checks all matching in-scope resources; false skips the check.
